cues.text: Look at these glowing mushrooms near the river bank!
Wait! Do not eat those, they look weird!
Oh no, my hands are turning green!
Peddy?! Where did you go?! You are a tiny frog now!
I told you not to eat magic things!
Look out, I am jumping into the pond!
Wait for me! Do not catch any flies without me!
Ribbit! Being a frog is actually super fun!
Okay, but you are walking home on two legs later!
